statement: On the exact shared-main head after the rs-raft operation-port foundation, statically classify whether partition rs-raft is ready for core convergence without changing production behavior. Bind the current backend-selection state, operation-port/runtime/lifecycle ownership, committed-ConfState membership authority, real MessageRouter transport status, remaining Liferaft consumers, exact-main release-proof state, documentation drift, and the terminal certification matrix. READY requires one intended production partition backend, real rs-raft transport/demux, no omission/error fallback to Liferaft, a current operation-boundary witness, proven restart/ConfState authority, a green exact-main release proof, every remaining Liferaft use classified, and zero UNKNOWN. If any predecessor obligation is missing, report BLOCKED_ON_RAFT_CUTOVER and stop; do not implement transport or cutover inside Q0.

constraints.statement: Q0 changes no src/ behavior. It is a census of the landed system.
Reuse the merged operation-port audit, receipts, runtime owner, lifecycle owner, membership-identity administration and real-partition witnesses; do not build a parallel boundary checker.
A BLOCKED_ON_RAFT_CUTOVER result is expected evidence, not permission to broaden Q0. Missing transport/default-selection/release-proof work belongs to its predecessor owner.
Committed rs-raft ConfState owns current consensus membership; placement policy, stable peer identity reservation, service/cache events and publication epochs remain distinct concerns.
An explicitly owned message-group Liferaft path is classified separately and is not treated as a partition cutover failure.
Every required Q0 axis must be classified; UNKNOWN is a red result.
